context: Reacting to a breaking security alert
purpose: React to a missile test; teach ミサイル/基地/停止/と共に/工業/大幅/輸出/崩壊

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今朝の速報、見た？ ミサイルの実験だって。
lines.en: See the morning alert? A missile test.
lines.style: alarmed friend sharing breaking news, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 基地の近くの住民が避難したらしいよ。
lines.en: Residents near the base reportedly evacuated.
lines.style: worried friend relaying details, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国際社会は、対話の停止を懸念してる。
lines.en: The international community fears a halt in dialogue.
lines.style: informed friend noting the reaction, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 緊張の高まりと共に、株価も動いたね。
lines.en: Along with rising tension, stocks moved too.
lines.style: observant friend linking markets, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 工業株が大幅に下がったって。
lines.en: Industrial stocks dropped sharply, they say.
lines.style: friend citing the market hit, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 輸出企業への影響も大きいみたい。
lines.en: The impact on exporters seems big too.
lines.style: friend extending the analysis, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最悪、地域秩序の崩壊もあり得るって専門家が。
lines.en: At worst, experts say regional order could collapse.
lines.style: grave friend quoting analysts, tone holding steady through the whole line
